steps.instructions: Write plan.md at the worktree root: the change in one paragraph; What already exists (the code that already does part of the job, with file paths); Smallest change (built on what exists, naming each brief instruction it does not follow and why); the files to touch and the tests to add or change; a scope block listing every file the task will change; open questions as needs-decision only if a choice is the owner's.

Follow plan.md when it exists and stay inside its scope block. Commit on the task branch. Add or change the tests that cover what you changed, and run only those. Report failures that are not this change's, and problems of the machine, as follow-ups instead of fixing them.

Run the project's test command, then the browser journeys for every screen the change touches, at desktop and phone widths, saving screenshots to .jevellan/evidence/. Report testsRun with passed true only when everything you ran passed, apart from failures you put in followUps as outside the task's scope or the machine's.
Update the docs the project keeps (README, docs/, changelog if the project uses one) for what changed. Nothing else.
